caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with a two-section design placed on a plain off-white background. The upper section consists of two glass-paneled doors, each containing six square glass panes with blue and gray shading that suggests reflection or transparency. The frame and borders of the cabinet are rendered in dark brown, giving a wooden appearance. Directly below the glass doors, the middle portion of the cabinet has two narrow drawers, each featuring a single yellowish knob for a handle. The lower section consists of two solid wooden doors with vertical handles, matching the material and color of the rest of the cabinet, and the cabinet stands on four short legs that are curved outward at the feet. The overall composition is centered within a lightly outlined rectangular border on the sheet.
title: China Cupboard
